sentences.text: Binod Kumbhar vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 7
November, 2025

Author: V. Narasingh
Bench: V. Narasingh
 In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
 Ablapl No. 12380 of 2025
 Binod Kumbhar .... Petitioner
 Mr. S. G. Das, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. S.N. Das, Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
Order No. 07.11.2025
01. 1.

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. No.689 of 2025 pending on the file of learned J.M.F.C., Kantabanji arising out of Kantabanji P.S. Case No.375 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 143(2)/143(3) of BNS read with Section 25 of Inter State Migrant Workmen (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service Act), 1979.

entities.text: Inter State Migrant Workmen (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service Act), 1979
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the Petitioner that he had a labour license for doing the work of bricks "bricks making" and the said license was valid till 31.12.2026 and the license authorizes him for recruiting maximum number of 100 during calendar year.

4. It is further submitted that the allegations in the case at hand is that the Petitioner was trying to transport more labour beyond the permission granted in terms of the transit permission and he was trying in transportation of 27 number of labours who are not listed.
5. Referring to the allegations, it is submitted that custodial interrogation is not warranted.

entities.text: Binod Kumbhar vs State Of Odisha
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 2. Kantabanji PS Case No-165/2011 U/s-120- B/367/368/371/374 IPC R.W Sec 12/14 SARAIS Act 3. Kantabanji PS Case No-203/2019
U/s- 374/420 IPC R/W. Sec 25 ISMW Act."
7. Considering the nature of allegation and the antecedents, this Court is not inclined to entertain the application for pre-arrest bail.
However, it is directed that Petitioner may surrender before the learned J.M.F.C., Kantabanji in connection with the aforementioned case within one month from today.

In the event of his surrender and motion for bail, the same be considered by the learned J.M.F.C.,
Kantabanji on merits, in the first hour of the day.
In the event of rejection of the prayer for bail by the learned J.M.F.C., Kantabanji, the Petitioner is at liberty to move the higher forum for bail in the second hour on the same day.
8. On being so moved, the higher forum is requested to make an endeavor to dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day.

The case diary shall be made available to the concerned courts to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner and learned J.M.F.C., Kantabanji is called upon to transmit the case record to the higher forum at the earliest in the event of rejection of such bail application.
Ground of parity, if any, may be considered by the learned court(s) below.
9. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
10. U.C.C. as per rules.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Santoshi Location: High Court of Orissa, Cuttack Binod Kumbhar vs State Of Odisha ....
